Overview

Dornbirn is a city in Vorarlberg with a population of 50,360. The largest city in Vorarlberg, a gateway to the Bregenz Forest and Alpine region, known for its textile industry heritage and modern architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
